newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to invite bids for stake in power plant.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to invite bids for stake in power plant.

text.p: Pakistan's Privatisation Minister Naveed Qamar said on Tuesday that bids for a 26 percent stake in the state-owned Jamshoro power plant to a strategic investor would be invited in October.

"Short-listing of prospective buyers has already been done and final sale bids will be invited in October," he told a news conference. He said six companies had started financial evaluation of the 880-megawatt thermal power station, which will be the second Pakistan has privatised.
In June Pakistan handed management control of the 1,600-MW Kot Addu power plant to Britain's National Power Plc.
